title: The merge-commit check passes a builder in a fresh worktree on a test-author's merge
why: Follow-up from #1683 (mixed-merge-resolver) review: the check should judge only the current agent's commits, and the backslash mutant is missing.
note: Coordinator pick, 18:51 CST Nov 7, can be undone: scope shrinks.
